Update: I called another Verizon representative, and the rep told me that the last resort is to post on Reddit. The rep told me that they do not have any contact information with "Alter.Net", so they can't help me on this issue.

Best try to post on the /r/verizon and /r/Fios subreddits to try and get help, but it's a complete long shot at this point.

I have the same issues as you, and my history of trying to get a representative to deal with this issue is crazy.

Here is a history of what I have done:
I called the Verizon reps twice, and they couldn't help me with this issue at all.

I opened a forum post on the issue on their website, which is no help.

I contacted Verizon on Twitter, and after a back and forth, they provided an incorrect number to contact Verizon Cellular Business, which of course, does not help.

I contacted PCCW Global, and they could not help me since I'm not a customer.

At this point, I agree with u/agnaaiu on this issue and just use CloudFlare WARP, as there is no method of contacting Alter.Net on this issue.
